description: What is happening right now: mark price, current hourly funding, open interest (one-sided — counted once per contract, half of the both-sides figure Hyperliquid's own UI shows, so it is directly comparable with the oi_usd column the bar tools return), 24-hour traded notional and premium for up to 25 markets, taken straight from the venue's public API and stamped with the moment it was read. Use this for 'now' questions; the bar=1d and bar=1h tools answer completed intervals only.
name: live_market

LiveMarketRow.description: Snapshot of one market, as of the upstream fetch.

oi_usd.description:
`open_interest * mark_px` when both are present — one-sided, so it is
directly comparable with the datasets' `oi_usd` column.

open_interest.description:
Open interest in base units, counted once per contract (one-sided) — the
same convention, and therefore the same magnitude, as the datasets'
`open_interest` column.

as_of.description: When the snapshot was taken, UTC.

source.description: `hyperliquid_rest` — this is the live market, not the completed-day data.

title: Live market snapshot
